train_starspace_model: train a Starspace model using starwrap by setting trainFile and trainMode then calling init and train
find_nearest_neighbors: find the 10 nearest neighbors for a given text string using the nearestNeighbor method
save_starspace_model: save a trained Starspace model to disk in binary or TSV format using saveModel or saveModelTsv
load_starspace_model: load a previously saved Starspace model from binary or TSV format using initFromSavedModel or initFromTsv
get_document_vector: get the document vector embedding for a text string using getDocVector with a specified separator
